failure_cases.must_fail_when: The dossier omits one of p2-91, p2-92, p2-94, p2-96, or p2-97.
The dossier changes or expands the allowed Opus conclusion tokens.
The dossier claims actual Opus approval.
The dossier claims mainline readiness, reviewed knowledge, evidence support, or action basis.
The dossier claims the overall goal is complete.
The dossier omits the requirement for later sandbox-only result intake.
This slice writes outside its own sandbox path.
